{{small|(12 June 2026)}} | attendance = 497,024 | average attendance = 3,861 | prevseason = [[2025 League of Ireland Premier Division|2025]] | nextseason = ''2027'' | updated = 16 May 2026 }} The '''2026 League of Ireland Premier Division''', known as the '''SSE Airtricity Men's Premier Division''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|url = https://www.leagueofireland.ie/news/key-dates-schedule-confirmed-2026-loi-season/| publisher = League of Ireland | title = Key dates - schedule confirmed for 2026 LOI season| date = 1 December 2025 | accessdate = 6 December 2025 }} is the 42nd season of the [[League of Ireland Premier Division]], the top Irish league for association football clubs since its establishment in 1985. The competition began on 6 February 2026 and is set to conclude on 30 October 2026.{{citeweb|last=Duffy|first=Muireann|title=Premier Division gets early February kick-off as League of Ireland season dates confirmed|date=1 December 2025|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/soccer/2025/12/01/premier-division-gets-early-february-kick-off-as-league-of-ireland-season-dates-confirmed/|publisher=[[The Irish Times]]|access-date=6 December 2025}} [[Shamrock Rovers F.C.|Shamrock Rovers]] are the defending champions, having won their 10th Premier Division title the [[2025 League of Ireland Premier Division|previous season]]. [[Sligo Rovers F.C.|Sligo Rovers]] were relegated on the 9 October following a 1-5 defeat to [[Shelbourne F.C.|Shelbourne]] at [[Tolka Park]] ending a 21 year stay in the top flight.{{Cite web |date=9 October 2026 |title=Rovers down after 5-1 hammering by Shelbourne |url=https://www.oceanfm.ie/sport/rovers-down-after-5-1-hammering-by-shelbourne-1487876 |website=OceanFM.ie}} == Teams == The league consists of ten teams – the top nine teams from the [[2025 League of Ireland Premier Division|previous season]] and one team promoted as champions from the [[2025 League of Ireland First Division|First Division]], [[Dundalk F.C.|Dundalk]].{{cite web|last=Rogers|first=James|title=Dundalk FC complete hard fought resurrection with promotion to Premier Division|date=11 October
